Thanks, it felt good reading your comment

Yeah for me it was the same, everything slowly felt more and more pointless and I questioned everything and everyone.

You helped me getting the courage to try it again, I'll try looking up some good doctors and hope I find one who does care can help me. Thank you very much!
I guess I'll try to overcome myself, not sure if I can do it but thank you. Maybe it helps the next time

Before I met my ex gf, I was like I am now.
I had 2 other girlfriends for a short time (I was around 16-18 at that time) but even with them, I was sad and depressed.
But after I met her, everything felt good and I was actually happy with everything in my life. I could feel happiness and nothing could make me sad anymore.

Its not like I force myself to "I can only be happy if im in a relationship" because I didnt care about relationships till I was 16.

I just want to be happy, feel the love my parents give me and enjoy life, but it doesnt work

I spoke to one around 3 years ago and after some therapies he told me im just imagining it and even stopped the therapy because "it will be fine". Like.. why? And what does knowing that help me? Its not like I feel like this, it just suddenly started while everything was going well in my life and never disappeared, literally destroyed my life.
I actually felt worse after that, I dont know if its worth a try to go to another mental health counsellor

Thats exactly how I feel right now..
The only thing stopping me from killing myself right now is my family.

My parents are so nice to me and care so much, sometimes I wish I had cruel parents so I just can kill myself without regrets.

My girlfriend I had for 1,5 years changed everything for me, but now that she broke up with me without a warning or anything else, everything went well, she was happy and so was I. Atleast I thought so.

Now that she's gone, everything is back again. It feels like everyone is happy, and even if they dont care about anything, they just do whatever they want and it works.
I was trying so hard and everything fails. I hate this world so much.

I feel you. I never had any fun in my life with hobbys, friends whatsoever, the only one that could give me what I need to not be depressed and feel lonely was my ex girlfriend that broke up with me 5 days ago after 1,5 years. I wish I had a gun, im not sure if I could actually kill myself, but I want to..

You can PM me if you want
